app.name: Phase
app.one_liner: An open-source Magic: The Gathering rules engine and game client built with Rust, WASM, and React.

screens.name: Game Lobby & Deck Builder
screens.purpose: Allows players to create or join games, configure settings, and build or select decks for play.

rust_commands.name: CreateGameWithSettings
rust_commands.purpose: Initiates a new game session with specified parameters including player seats and AI configurations.

rust_commands.name: DraftAction
rust_commands.purpose: Processes draft-related actions including submission of draft codes during limited formats.

rust_commands.name: SeatMutate
rust_commands.purpose: Updates seat assignments and AI deck payloads during lobby setup.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add input length limits to DraftAction.draft_code
week 1: Enforce payload size constraints in SeatMutate
week 1: Implement bounded validation for ai_seats in CreateGameWithSettings
acceptance_tests: DraftAction fails gracefully when draft_code exceeds 256 characters
SeatMutate returns error on unbounded AI deck payloads
WebSocket recovers from send failures without hanging the client
